transforms.operation: Resolve each attaching datasheet's English display name to its repository leader id while processing its bodyguard groups.
Convert the resolved datasheet display name into the repository entity id.

filters: Ignore Legends and Combat Patrol datasheets, unresolved names, and leaders absent from the faction unit file.
precedence: For the separate unit attachment_role side effect in runAttachmentRoles, support applies only when every group is support; any leader group wins so the flat role never over-constrains a solo-capable character.
A dump-derived leader-attachments record supersedes an existing record with the same leader_id; records for leaders absent from the dump are preserved.
/leader_id.reason: The bodyguard-group leader datasheet is converted to the repository leader id by the current attachment projection; bodyguardType also drives the documented leader-wins unit-role flattening.

transforms.operation: Traverse unconditional groups only, resolve permitted bodyguard datasheets to repository IDs, deduplicate, and sort.
Convert each resolved permitted-bodyguard display name into the repository entity id.

filters: Retain only bodyguards in the current faction directory from groups without roster conditions.
precedence: The junction is an eligibility relation, never ownership.
A dump-derived record supersedes the existing record for the same leader_id; a leader with only conditional groups has an empty unconditional array.
/eligible_bodyguard_ids.reason: This array contains only unconditional eligibility; roster-dependent bodyguards remain in conditional_groups.

transforms.operation: Resolve, deduplicate, and sort each eligible bodyguard into a repository unit id.
Convert the permitted bodyguard datasheet display name into its repository entity id.

filters: Retain only ids in the current faction unit file from groups without roster conditions.
precedence: The eligibility junction does not establish unit ownership.
Sorted unique ids are emitted for unconditional groups; conditional-only leaders carry an empty array.
/eligible_bodyguard_ids/*.reason: Each item is an unconditional permitted bodyguard.

transforms.operation: Traverse each leader group's keyword edges and collect the resolved labels in dump-edge (GW-canonical) order without sorting.
Resolve each bodyguard-group keyword id to its English keyword label.

filters: Emitted only on a record that already carries explicit eligible_bodyguard_ids (the schema mandates at least one id); a keyword-only group cannot form a standalone record.

Sources only the datasheet_bodyguard_group_keyword edge (the 'any unit with ALL these keywords' eligibility, e.g. an Inquisitor leading any IMPERIUM BATTLELINE INFANTRY unit); the per-group requiresAllUnitsHaveKeywordId constraint is a distinct form and is not folded in.
precedence: Keyword order follows the dump edge order (GW-canonical), so an authored value is confirmed rather than reordered.
/eligible_bodyguard_keywords.reason: The bodyguard-group keyword edge is resolved to keyword labels and emitted as additive keyword-based eligibility alongside the explicit ids.

transforms.operation: Each member is one bodyguard-group keyword id resolved to its English keyword label.

/eligible_bodyguard_keywords/*.reason: Each member is a keyword label resolved from a datasheet_bodyguard_group_keyword edge.

transforms.operation: Retain each roster-conditional bodyguard group separately with its role.

/conditional_groups.reason: Conditional eligibility cannot be flattened into the unconditional bodyguard set.

transforms.operation: Project one conditioned source group per emitted attachment variant.

/conditional_groups/*.reason: Each conditional group retains its own source role and roster predicates.

transforms.operation: Copy the source group's leader or support role.

/conditional_groups/*/role.reason: An active conditional group overrides the flat unit role.

transforms.operation: Resolve eligible bodyguard datasheets to unit IDs within this group.

/conditional_groups/*/eligible_bodyguard.reason: Group-local eligibility must be checked alongside roster conditions.

transforms.operation: Convert one permitted bodyguard datasheet into a repository unit ID.

/conditional_groups/*/eligible_bodyguard.reason: Each item is a resolved eligible bodyguard for the conditional group.

transforms.operation: Resolve every required roster datasheet for this group to a unit ID.

/conditional_groups/*/required_roster_un.reason: All required units must be present for this group to apply.

transforms.operation: Convert one required roster datasheet to a unit ID.

/conditional_groups/*/required_roster_un.reason: A condition references a concrete roster unit.

transforms.operation: Resolve excluded roster datasheets to unit IDs for this group.

/conditional_groups/*/excluded_roster_un.reason: No excluded unit may be present for this group to apply.

transforms.operation: Convert one excluded roster datasheet to a unit ID.

/conditional_groups/*/excluded_roster_un.reason: A condition references a concrete roster unit.

transforms.operation: Attach the repository-confirmed game-version context to each emitted leader-attachment record.

/game_version.reason: The emitted game version is repository context, not inferred from an MFM bodyguard row.

transforms.operation: Copy the repository-confirmed dataslate context into emitted records.
Copy the repository-confirmed edition context into emitted records.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: An excluded-detachment eligibility restriction has no destination in leader-attachment.schema.json and is not projected.
A required-detachment eligibility restriction has no destination in leader-attachment.schema.json and is not projected.

A distinct per-group form: a single keyword every already-listed bodyguard must additionally carry, not the 'any unit with these keywords qualifies' edge that eligible_bodyguard_keywords models (that is datasheet_bodyguard_group_keyword, now consumed). Its combination semantics with the explicit ids are unresolved, so it is not folded in.
